_comment: Values the catalog gives only in prose, and gaps the exporter needs filled. Every entry says where it comes from. Move these into catalog tables when the catalog gets them.

unit_classes._source: Rows with no class at the start of «Особое». Temporary class `civilian`, to confirm in the catalog.

building_overrides._source: ВКЛ tab «Отличия в общих постройках»; «Общие постройки», row wall, column «Что даёт»
building_overrides._crown_source: Корона tab, «Уникальные постройки»: pl_salt_works «Ставится на соляном источнике; 0,3 серебра/с без крестьян; не больше 2» (tag on_salt_spring, limit, silver_milli); pl_battery «1–2 бомбарды» (guns: how many bombards fire from one battery at a time)

tech_cost_permille._source: Корона tab: «Трёхполье у Короны дешевле на треть»

faith_tech_building._source: Inferred: ВКЛ tab says pagan faith technologies come only from the alka; other factions research them in the temple

tech_place_aliases._source: Names in the «Где» column that differ from the building's name

combat_rules._source: Catalog «Обзор и правила» → «Урон», «Боевой дух», «Сверка статов»; ВКЛ tab → «Литовский отход»; banner_morale: «Боевой дух» → «знамя хоругви рядом +10» (ВКЛ 2). The catalog states these only in prose. Keys in `_temporary` are not in the catalog at all: guesses for M4, to confirm or move into the catalog.
combat_rules._crown_source: The Crown (2026-10-18). tabor_link_ticks and tabor_armor: Корона tab, «Табор» («сцепляются за 10 секунд», «+3/+3 брони»). Temporary: escort_radius_milli (how near the knight's lance «рядом с копьём» is), pavise_cover_cells (how far behind the pavise its cover reaches), tabor_link_cells (wagons this close to each other belong to one ring).

economy_rules._source: Catalog «Обзор и правила» → «Эпохи, население, сбор» (carry, pop_cap, gather rates, tree, ore and silver amounts); ВКЛ tab → «Засеки» (zaseka_cells) and gdl_bort «2 крестьянина» (bort_workers); Орден tab → «Кирпич» (brick discounts). The catalog states these only in prose. Keys in `_temporary` are not in the catalog at all: guesses for M5, to confirm or move into the catalog. dismantle_refund_permille: Valentin 2026-10-16, own buildings are taken apart by peasants for 80% of their price, carried to storage; lowered to 50% by Valentin the same day.
economy_rules._crown_source: salt_spring_silver: «Локации» → o_salt_spring «другие могут поставить рудницу на 300 серебра» (the spring's own silver, mined like a deposit until a salt works covers it).

building_layout._source: Not in the catalog: footprints in cells (w, h) are temporary, after AoE II. Tags: walkable = units walk over it (fields, hives); gate = lets its owner's units through; in_forest = every cell must be forest (ВКЛ: «Ставится в лесу»); no_age_count = does not count toward «2 постройки Удела» (temporary, after AoE II); brick_discount = cheaper while the owner has a building tagged brickworks (Орден → «Кирпич»: стены, башни и замки); power_place_only = only on a place of power (catalog, «Общие постройки» → shrine; M7); spell_recharge = own znakharki near it recharge faster (Алка «знахарки рядом перезаряжаются на 20% быстрее», magic_rules). fireproof = does not burn (M9; catalog «Городня»: «Камень и кирпич не горят» for the Order's brick castle, brickworks and the stone walls; fields are not buildings that burn, temporary).
building_layout._sight_source: Fog of war (M6): how far a finished building sees, in cells → params.sight. Only mo_watchtower «Обзор 12» is from the catalog; the rest are temporary, after AoE II. watch tag = towers and walls for t_watch «Обзор башен и стен +2». Gate 6: its archers see as far as they shoot (Valentin 2026-10-17: 1–2 archers on a gate).

vision_rules._source: Fog of war (M6). hill_sight_bonus: catalog «Локации» → t_hill «+2 обзора». cover_reveal_cells: plan M6 «юнит в лесу не виден с дистанции больше 2 клеток» (the same 2 cells as «Болотный туман»). Keys in `_temporary` are not in the catalog.

magic_rules._source: Places of power and spells (M7). capture_ticks (15 s) and power_cap: plan M7 «захват 15 секунд без чужих в радиусе», «потолок 500». consecration_permille: «Магия и места силы» → Орденская часовня «вдвое меньше». alka_recharge_permille: Алка «знахарки рядом перезаряжаются на 20% быстрее». relic_morale_floor and relic_enemy_morale: sp_relic «Свои не бегут, пока дух выше 10; враги рядом −10 духа». exorcism_creature_damage: sp_exorcism «существо теряет 150 HP». storm_strikes and storm_damage: sp_perkunas «3 молнии по 80 урона в самые тяжёлые цели». icon_morale_floor: sp_icon «Дух отрядов рядом с иконой не падает ниже 50», read as percent of full morale, as the ВКЛ 5 card puts it («не падает ниже половины»). Keys in `_temporary` are not in the catalog: capture_radius (cells around the site), alka_recharge_radius («рядом»), cast_range (how far from the caster a spell aimed at a point may land).
magic_rules._crown_source: The Crown (2026-10-18), «Заклинания»: hymn_morale sp_bogurodzica «+25 духа, бегущие отряды возвращаются в бой»; blessing_armor and blessing_morale sp_banner_blessing «+2/+2 брони и +10 духа одному отряду»; pact_damage_permille sp_pact «Дух не падает, урон +25%». heal_radius_default is temporary: healers whose «лечит N HP/с» names no radius (ксёндз, инок) heal around them this far.

skirmish_rules._source: How a skirmish is won (M8). Concept doc «Игровой цикл» → «Победа в схватке: уничтожение столицы и замков или удержание всех мест силы в течение 5 минут»: hold_all_places_ticks = 5 min at 20 ticks a second.

fire_rules._source: Arson and fire (M9; mission card ВКЛ 1 «Поджог»: деревянные стены и дома горят, огонь наносит урон со временем и перекидывается на соседние деревянные постройки, защитники тушат). From the catalog: zaseka_burn_ticks (ВКЛ → gdl_zaseka «огонь сжигает за 20 с»); that «горит медленно» exists (gdl_wall, mo_wall: tag burns_slowly) and that stone and brick do not burn (building_layout tag fireproof). Every other number is a guess for M9 (`_temporary`): ignite_ticks is the torch of any unit (Румбаудас «Поджог постройки за 5 с» is his own ability), burn_ticks is how long a fire takes to eat a building's full HP, slow_burn_permille scales that for burns_slowly, a fire tries to jump to each flammable building within spread_cells every spread_every_ticks with chance spread_permille, the owner's free units within douse_radius_cells come to put it out and need douse_ticks unit-ticks of work.

heroes._source: Heroes (M9): catalog «Герои: шаблоны» gives HP, damage, armor, speed, aura and the template ability; it says nothing of classes, reload or which side a hero is on. template_classes: mounted and sovereign ride as heavy cavalry, light as light cavalry (Румбаудас leads a cavalry troop), the lady and civilians go on foot; reload_ticks is 2,0 s like most units; factions are given only for the heroes the prototype loads.

spell_effects._source: How each spell is aimed (target_point: a point within magic_rules.cast_range of the caster; target_self: around the caster, moving with it; passive) and the effect the simulation runs (mist, dispel, relic, icon, consecration), read from «Эффект» in «Заклинания». Spells without an entry are not in the game yet and cannot be cast.
spell_effects._crown_source: The Crown (2026-10-18): «Богородица» is sung around the priest (radius 12, moving with him); «Благословение хоругви» is laid on one own unit at the point (radius «1 отряд»: tag single_target); «Договор» around its caster (radius 6).

tech_effects._source: «Эффект» of «Общие технологии» and the faction tabs, written as numbers: gather_* and farm_food are per-mille increases; zaseka_speed and zaseka_hp too (×2 speed = +1000); wall_sight adds cells of sight to the player's buildings tagged watch; «<class or unit id>.<stat>» changes unit stats for the player's units of that class (heal: HP a second a healer gives); «<spell id>.radius» adds cells to the player's spell, «<spell id>.cost_permille» changes its Сила price (−300 = 30% cheaper). tabor_wagons and tabor_armor change the Crown's wagon fort (fewer wagons needed, more armor inside); salt_rate raises what salt works give, per mille.

_deferred.t_gdl_horodlo: researched in the Грод, which is not in the prototype; lance morale and price, alkas −20% Сила
_deferred.t_to_rossdienst: free halfbrother every 3 minutes per castle: next combat pass
_deferred.t_pl_great_banner: a standard-bearer unit is not in the catalog (who carries the kingdom's banner, and how it is raised again when it falls); like t_banners
